data_fields.name: sound_delay
data_fields.donor_constant: caller units divided by game speed (delay_rate)

data_fields.name: music_fade_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (close at once); proposed 1000

best_idea: A fixed voice pool where a new sound steals the lowest-priority voice that is not above it, with one chance roll per play, a delay counted in game-speed units, and stop-by-owner so a dying creature's loops stop with it.
decision_why: The steal rule, one-roll chance gate and owner-scoped stop fit many-on-one hit sounds; the donor's lowest-index tie rule, its effectively unlimited 4096-voice pool and its hard music close must be fixed before use.
acceptance: With ten hits landing inside one second, no more than 32 hit voices play at once; a death cue at higher priority takes the oldest hit voice; a creature's loop stops when its owner dies; the music never cuts out for a hit.
